text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Every “miracle” that graces a horse girl 
is something profoundly sacred.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Whether it be fulfilling a long-cherished 
dream, 
or recreating her former glory at its 
absolute peak.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
When granted, tears fall like passing 
showers… 
A horse girl holds the power to forge a 
future 
that no soul could ever have imagined.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: And yet――

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
…――――And yet, even the simple act of 
“being here.”

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Even meeting once again as a horse girl 
sharing that soul, 
despite possessing a different form and 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
I believe that too is a miracle born from 
the bond held by this name, 
and the love bestowed upon it by humans.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: …That is what I truly believe.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid work! The Goshiki Shuntaisai you 
delivered 
was nothing short of magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Especially you, <chrname>, 
and you, Trainer <username>. 
You fulfilled your grand duty to the very 
end!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Take some time to rest and recover. 
Enjoy a leisurely break with <chrname>.

And so, I decided to spend a full, 
relaxing day with <chrname>. 
The place we ended up visiting was――

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wah, you're here too!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What's this, what's this? 
Art thou an idle wanderer as well? Nothing 
better to do?
choice_data_list:
Well, we just wanted to take it easy for a 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Both the Goshiki Shuntaisai and the races 
are wrapped up for now. 
It totally makes sense to wanna zone out!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. But look at that, every single one 
of us 
ended up comin' right back to the 
racecourse, 
even with no races on today.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. 
…Partly because of that “dream” we had on 
the night of the festival.
choice_data_list: A dream on the night of the festival?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. 
A really, really wondrous dream.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A dream about humans and “Daiwa Scarlet” 
that made you want to hold it close 
forever.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait, since we're all here anyway, 
why don't we all go say thanks to that 
person together!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! 
The person who helped us out during the 
Goshiki Shuntaisai――

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The person who helped us… wait, who was it 
again…?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's unusual. 
For Mayano to draw a complete blank.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever! Let's head to the festival 
grounds 
and give our thanks to everyone who's 
there!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Aah! The Soaring Gallop Association 
President and the closing dance teacher 
are here! 
Thank you so much for all your hard 
work――!

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Association President
text_block_list.text:
My, everyone is here…! 
What a coincidence. We had just arrived 
here ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. It seems great minds truly do 
think alike 
at the very same time.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
To those who poured love and dreams into 
our names. 
And to those who called our names out 
loud.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And above all, to those who first bore 
this name, 
and forged the very first bond with 
humankind.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
We offer our deepest gratitude. 
――Right here, right now.
(Clang… clatter, clatter…)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …What was that sound…?
choice_data_list: I'll go check it out for a second.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait! 
Trainer!

With an inexplicable flutter in my chest, 
I followed the sound toward its source. 
And there――
lay an old horseshoe on the ground.
――Thank you, you who once called my name.
――Thank you, you who calls my name now.

…I had no idea whose voice it was, 
echoing softly from somewhere unknown.

Yet, hearing that voice brought something 
back to mind――

Connecting horse girls and humans. 
“There was a horse girl who spoke of how 
precious that was.” 
――A wondrous, fleeting memory like that.

title: What the Calling Voice Yields Is Miracles and Love,
